business_scope.primary_industry_name: Operating and Financial Leasing of Turbofan Aircraft Engines

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Decreto 410 de 1971 (Código de Comercio); Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF regime); Ley 1121 de 2006 (aml/cft measures); Decreto 830 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales); Circular Básica Jurídica 100-000008 de 2022 (Superintendencia de Sociedades AML/CFT obligations)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of legal existence and representation (certificado de existencia y representación legal) of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or bilateral Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted by the foreign shareholder to the Colombian legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or bilateral Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the foreign shareholder's constitutional documents (bylaws or charter)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or bilateral Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or solvency of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or authorized issuing authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or bilateral Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: PEP, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU consolidated list, and Colombian national sanctions lists screening is mandatory for all proposed shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, directors, legal representatives, and authorized signatories. Enhanced due diligence applies to aircraft engine leasing counterparties and PEP-related relationships. Screening evidence must be archived for at least ten years; any discrepancy must be reported to the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (https://www.rues.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or transliterated into Spanish using the Latin alphabet without foreign scripts. The name must follow Spanish corporate nomenclature and the S.A.S. suffix must be included. Foreign words are admitted only where they are clearly distinctive and have been transliterated phonetically; any term that misleads as to nationality, public status, or regulated activity is prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name reservation or homonymy certificate is rejected, the requesting party may file an administrative reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) before the registering Cámara de Comercio within ten business days of notification. If the rejection is confirmed, the requesting party may file an appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within ten additional business days. The appeal must include the proposed name, the RUES rejection notice, and evidence of the applicant's exclusive entitlement or priority; a new fee is required only if a fresh search is initiated after final refusal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is generally tolerated for non-licensed holding and lease-management activities during the pre-operational stage, provided a physical Colombian address is designated for legal notices and service of process. For an aircraft engine dry-leasing vehicle, a virtual office may be accepted only if no on-site regulated activity is performed; however, the DIAN may reassess tax residence and economic substance where substance is insufficient.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium – quantified at 30–35% probability of a Chamber of Commerce or DIAN unannounced inspection within the first 12 months where a virtual office is used; reduced to approximately 15% where a physical registered office with basic managerial substance is established.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and homonymy certificate search for two candidate corporate names
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff established by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Electronic pre-registration filing of the S.A.S. standard incorporation document on RUES
Merchant registration (matrícula mercantil) and registration of corporate bylaws
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on initial capital and asset value, prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille bundle for four foreign corporate documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff schedule and Hague Apostille fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscription for all UBOs, shareholders, and legal representatives
Registered office (virtual) for 12 months covering legal notices and service of process
Initial UBO register filing and adoption of trust-compliance corporate governance clause
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized registry service provider or DIAN electronic filing system
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Technical processing fee and statutory compliance filing benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal representative's electronic signature and DIAN security token issuance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for certification authority services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime), Articles 1, 4, 5 and 17; Colombian Commercial Code (Decree 410 of 1971), Articles 110, 353-372; Decree 1074 of 2015 (Single Regulatory Decree for Commerce); Superintendencia de Sociedades interpretive circulars.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), with supervision by Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument) with registered bylaws (estatutos sociales), formalized in the Mercantile Register (Registro Mercantil) via the RUES.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-in capital required for a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada; capital may be subscribed with payment deferred up to two years from incorporation; no escrow account is statutorily required. For aircraft engine leasing, subscribed capital should reflect asset acquisition requirements; cash or in-kind contributions (including the leased engines) are permissible.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: By unanimous written consent of the sole founding shareholder(s) of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., pursuant to the private incorporation instrument under Law 1258 of 2008, it is RESOLVED: 1. Capital Stock. The subscription and disbursement of authorized shares be ratified, and received funds recognized as paid-in equity. 2. Registered Office. The registered office is established at [ADDRESS], [CITY], Colombia; the legal representative is authorized to execute lease or purchase agreements securing said premises. 3. Appointments. [NAME] is appointed Legal Representative, and [NAME] Deputy Representative, each with full and unrestricted powers. 4. Further Matters. Appointees are authorized to effect registration before the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and all competent authorities. Unanimously approved and executed in [CITY], [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Verification (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social via online RUES portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name consultation to the Chamber of Commerce of the intended corporate domicile using the RUES homologation module. Request preliminary approval of the proposed corporate name (Certificado de Homonimias). Verify the absence of identical or substantially similar registered names and obtain the approval certificate, which remains valid for 30 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Completed RUES name consultation form
Copy of the legal representative's or founding shareholder's identification document
Up to five (5) alternative proposed corporate name options
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for similarity with an existing entity, resubmit the application with the alternative names previously declared. An appeal (recurso de reposición) may be filed before the Chamber Secretary within 10 business days in accordance with the Colombian Administrative Procedure Code (Ley 1437 de 2011); repeat consultation after 30 days if grounds of similarity are resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Incorporation Instrument and Bylaws (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Self-executed by founding shareholders and, when real property is contributed, formalized before a Notaría Pública (notary public).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation instrument and complete Spanish-language bylaws containing all S.A.S. mandatory clauses: corporate name, domicile, and duration; object clause covering aircraft engine acquisition, operating and financial leasing, and aviation asset administration; subscribed and paid-up capital schedule with payment term not exceeding two years; classes and voting rights of shares; representation and management bodies; audit and inadvertent auditor provisions; dissolution grounds; and arbitration or judicial dispute resolution clause. Obtain signatures of all subscribing shareholders; if real estate is part of the contribution, instrument must be escalated to public deed before a notary.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation instrument and bylaws in Spanish
Annex listing full names, domiciles and tax IDs of every subscribing shareholder
Share subscription and payment schedule (capital allocation matrix)
Certificate of name authorization (Certificado de Homonimia)
Identification documents of each shareholder (Cédula de Ciudadanía, NIT, or passport)
For public deed route: notarial fee deposit voucher
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any legal drafting deficiency identified by counsel or the notary; re-execute signatures where a shareholder's consent is defective; re-notarize if any clause conflicts with mandatory provisions of Law 1258 of 2008; reissue the instrument with corrected page numbering and marginal notes before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce in the Mercantile Register (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Registro Único Empresarial y Social — RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online pre-registration form in RUES and upload the executed incorporation instrument together with all supporting dossiers. Electronically pay the registration fee (derechos de inscripción) and the registration tax computed on subscribed capital. Attach the sworn statement that the appointed legal representative has no disqualifying impediment. Upon successful review, download the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which evidences legal existence and legal capacity of the S.A.S.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument (original if private; notarial copy if public deed)
Certificado de Homonimia issued in Step 1
Acceptance letters signed by the Legal Representative and Deputy Legal Representative
Sworn statement of no legal impediments (certificación de no estar incurso en causales de inhabilidad)
PRE-RUT pre-registration generated on the DIAN portal
Copies of identification documents of shareholders and appointed officers
Proof of payment of registration fee and registration tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an observación (query), cure the deficiency within 30 business days before the file is archived; if the file is declared inactive, reinitiate with a fresh registration request and payment of applicable late fees; minor inconsistencies may be cured by filing a correction annex (anexo de corrección) before the same Chamber under Decree 1074 de 2015.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration with DIAN — NIT and RUT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (online via MUISCA portal, www.dian.gov.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Chamber-issued Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, access the MUISCA electronic portal and complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application. Obtain the company NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and classify the entity as a general regime income taxpayer. Declare the ICA (industry and commerce) obligation, the presumed leasing activity classified under the Colombian Tax Statute (income; ICA taxable IAB if applicable), and designate the legal representative as the tax-attributed responsible party. Apply for the digital electronic invoicing certificate (facturación electrónica).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued within the last 90 days by the Chamber of Commerce
Identification document and RUT of the legal representative
Completed RUT application form
Proof of registered office address (lease contract or public utilities bill)
Chamber of Commerce registration certificate evidencing bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NIT issuance is delayed or blocked, file a derecho de petición under Ley 1755 de 2015 and request a written response; recertify the registered address with a utility bill if the DIAN risk profile flags the address; escalate to the DIAN tax ombudsman (defensoría del contribuyente) after 15 business days of inaction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Tax, Employer and Operational Registration (ICA, SG-SST, ARL, Electronic Invoicing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda (ICA), Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), Caja de Compensación Familiar, EPS and Pension Fund administrators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A.S. for the Industria y Comercio (ICA) municipal tax with the district or municipal tax office (for Bogotá: Subdirección de Impuestos a la Producción y al Consumo). Register the company as an employer with the chosen ARL and a family compensation fund (CCF); enroll the legal representative and any employees in EPS and pension fund regimes. Implement the initial SG-SST (workplace safety and health management system) under Decree 1072 de 2015 and issue internal workplace regulations. Elect the DIAN-authorized software provider and formally activate the electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) mechanism, including the Validador del Proveedor Tecnológico. This step completes the operational profile for lawful invoicing of aircraft engine dry lease receivables.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
NIT/RUT issued by DIAN
ICA registration form (Formulario Único de Inscripción)
Lease contract or proof of registered office address
Draft SG-SST initial program and emergency response plan
Electronic invoicing provider contract (Acuerdo de Vinculación)
Employer registration form (Form 01) for social security entities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve ICA registration discrepancies by filing an amendment rectification annex before the local tax office under the applicable municipal tax code; if SG-SST or ARL registration is delayed, escalate through the respective entity's PQRS (peticiones, quejas, reclamos y sugerencias) channel; late ICA or employer registration may be voluntarily disclosed within 5 business days to benefit from reduced sanctions under Ley 962 de 2005.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil (UAEAC) — applicable exclusively to the lessee's operational approvals and to any engine lease registration under RAC regulations; the S.A.S. lessor, holding ownership without operational control, requires no aeronautical operating license. No manufacturing or industrial permit applies to a pure dry leasing activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — dry operating leasing of turbofan aircraft engines is a purely commercial lease activity in Colombia. Financial leasing with purchase option is a supervised activity of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; an operating lease structured through a non-financial S.A.S. does not require a financial authorization, banking license, or industrial manufacturing permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) in coordination with the regional environmental authority (Corporación Autónoma Regional — CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: No EIA required — dry leasing of aircraft engines is a service activity without significant environmental impact; an environmental license or environmental registration is not triggered under Law 99 of 1993, Decree 1076 de 2015 and ANLA Resolution 1526 de 2012. Registration classification would apply only if the lessor physically maintains engine test-cell facilities or large-volume parts storage warehouses.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For office-only operations: wastewater discharged to public sewers must meet Resolución 0631 de 2015 (pH 6-9, BOD5 maximal 400 mg/L, COD 700 mg/L); ambient air quality protective limits under Resolución 2254 de 2017 (PM10 annual average 50 µg/m³; NO2 60 µg/m³). If depots or maintenance subcontracting are introduced, hazardous waste generated (used oils, coolants, contaminated rags) must be managed per Decree 4741 de 2005, including generator registration and manifest conditions, and discharged liquids must comply with the applicable effluent parameters before municipal sewer discharge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos fire-safety inspection certificate and annual renewal for the registered office; municipal planning verification of land use compatibility (Certificado de Uso del Suelo); structural load inspection may be required by the Chamber of Commerce if the registered office is in a commercial tower; mandatory workplace health and safety program (SG-SST) registration with the selected ARL under Decree 1072 de 2015; emergency and disaster response plan coordination with the municipal risk management council per Ley 1523 de 2012; compliance with the workplace capacity and occupational hazard notification requirements of Decree 1443 de 2014.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Directorate of Taxes and Customs), portal: www.dian.gov.co; operational systems: Muisca (registration and filing) and Factura Electrónica (e-invoicing validation).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) must first be incorporated before a Notary and registered with the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) to obtain the certificado de existencia y representación legal. The legal representative must then apply through the DIAN Muisca portal for the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), which is the sole statutory tax ID. A non-resident foreign entity without a Colombian permanent establishment may obtain a simplified RUT/NIT via a locally appointed fiscal representative with a notarized power of attorney, solely for VAT withholding, e-invoicing, and import/export reporting obligations. The RUT is valid for all tax purposes, must be updated within five business days of any change, and must be accompanied by the registration of the DIAN-approved electronic invoicing software solution.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Colombian tax law; the S.A.S. is by default a Colombian tax resident entity subject to entity-level taxation on worldwide income. No hybrid mismatch election is available; however, the taxpayer may elect to apply the permanent establishment attribution rules for a branch operation, may opt into the special dividend distribution treatment under Estatuto Tributario Articles 242 and 245, and may elect to treat cross-border engine leases as export services under Article 481 E.T. where the statutory export conditions are met.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Colombia has no general economic turnover threshold for VAT registration; any person, including a foreign entity with a permanent establishment, deriving taxable income from the sale of goods or rendering of services in Colombian territory must register in the RUT and declare IVA from the first transaction. The simplified regime (Régimen Simplificado) applies only to natural persons with gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 161 million for 2024), and is unavailable to an S.A.S., which is always in the Régimen Común. For cross-border engine dry leasing, VAT nexus arises only if the engine or its use is physically located in Colombia or if the lessee is a Colombian resident; otherwise the lease is treated as an export service and zero-rated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) is in force for all S.A.S. entities. Invoices must be generated via DIAN-certified software and transmitted in real time to DIAN's SIE (Servicios Informáticos Electrónicos) platform using an XML digital format, a digital signature certificate issued by a DIAN-authorized certification authority, and a unique validation code (CUFE/CUDE). DIAN performs pre-issuance validation; no invoice is legally valid without digital clearance. Additionally, the aircraft engine export invoice must be cross-referenced with the Formulario 510 export declaration in the VUCE/VUPE customs system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The dry lease (arrendamiento seco) of aircraft engines rendered by a Colombian S.A.S. to a foreign airline qualifies for the 0% VAT export rate under Article 481 E.T. and Decree 1625 of 2016, Section 1.3.1.19.1, provided that: (i) the lessee has no domicile in Colombia; (ii) the engine is exclusively located and exploited outside Colombian territory throughout the lease term; (iii) the service is technically and commercially linked to the international air transport business; and (iv) the lease payments are received through Colombian foreign exchange channels. Income from such lease is also treated as foreign-source income, reinforcing the zero-rating; any partial use of the engine in Colombian territory disqualifies the export treatment and reclassifies the lease as a taxable IIA subject to 19% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Formulario 510 – Declaración de Exportación (DIAN customs export declaration) duly validated with export exit stamp or electronic authorization
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical removal of the aircraft engine from Colombian customs territory
Certificado de Cámara de Comercio evidencing the S.A.S. corporate existence and legal representation
Master Lease Agreement / Engine Dry Lease Agreement with the foreign air carrier, stating the engine serial number and foreign place of use
Commercial export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta) with 0% IVA rate and valid CUFE/CUDE code
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Compensación de Divisas) issued by an authorized Colombian foreign exchange intermediary evidencing the repatriation of lease proceeds
Non-residence certificate or domicile certificate of the foreign lessee (when required by DIAN)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retroactively reassess the 0% rate within five years from the filing deadline of the related IVA return, or up to ten years where no e-invoice or RUT registration exists. Upon reassessment, the taxpayer must pay the 19% VAT understatement plus daily late-payment interest (current commercial rate plus 50%) and a penalty ranging from 100% of the understated tax for inaccuracy to 200% for willful misrepresentation or fraud under Article 640 E.T. The zero-rating is automatically clawed back if the lease proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day term or if the engine is physically used in Colombia; criminal sanctions under Law 1943 of 2018 may also apply in cases of falsified customs declarations, forged bills of lading, or fictitious lease contracts, including asset forfeiture and imprisonment of the legal representative.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Junta Directiva del Banco de la República) issuing the Régimen de Cambios Internacionales under Decree 1068/2015, Book 16, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83; supervision by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and UIAF for AML.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of mercantile registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31 for all commercial registrants regardless of fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers per-day fines under the Chamber tariff; two consecutive years of non-renewal leads to administrative cancellation of the commercial registry registration and possible strike-off from the official register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting (Asamblea Ordinaria de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate body; minutes recorded in corporate books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 following the December 31 fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene or approve the financial statements blocks subsequent registry filings and exposes directors to civil liability and fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of financial statements (Depósito de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio; also Superintendencia de Sociedades when required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within fifteen business days after shareholders' approval; approval must occur by March 31, making the effective filing deadline approximately late April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit attracts administrative fines based on the entity's equity and may suspend registration and commercial activities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May of the following year, on staggered dates according to the taxpayer's NIT last digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of five percent of the omitted transaction value, up to 15,000 UVT, for late or non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual update of the Final Beneficiaries Register (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: UGPP (Unidad Administrativa Especial de Gestión Pensional y Contribuciones Parafiscales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually according to the UGPP filing calendar, generally between July and September of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or inaccurate submission subjects the company to monthly fines of 100 SMMLV and possible criminal sanctions for intentional omission

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is required when (1) total gross assets exceed 5,000 legal monthly minimum wages; (2) gross income exceeds 3,000 legal monthly minimum wages; or (3) the entity issues public securities, acts as a financial intermediary, or engages in certain regulated activities
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Information Standards using IFRS: full IFRS (NIIF) for Grupo 1, IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para PYMES) for Grupo 2, and micro-enterprise standards for Grupo 3 companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The entity must annually confirm and update its ultimate beneficial ownership information in the RUB portal operated by UGPP. The update must reflect all shareholding transfers and control changes occurring during the preceding calendar year, and must be filed within the annual window published by UGPP, typically falling between July and September.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Socios o Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Management Resolutions (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book for Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500–8,000 per year for a required Revisor Fiscal

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday for aircraft-engine leasing. The operation is liable to the standard 35% corporate rate. A potential deduction exists for research and technical development in aeronautical improvements under Article 158-1 of the Tax Statute, but no sector-specific exemption or reduced rate applies to ISIC 5223 dry leasing activities.
